name: Baird's Hoard
purpose: Shows the screen of another computer connected through an HDMI capture device (AVerMedia Live Gamer Portable Lite GL310 / C875) live in a window, and with one click saves a screenshot, the last seconds as a clip or a recording; every file can be dragged or copied straight into a chat. Assistants can look at that screen (the picture comes back as an image) and save screenshots, clips and recordings.
notes: screen_look returns the current picture of the other computer as an image (and keeps it as a screenshot unless save=false); media_look shows a saved file. clip_save copies the last seconds from memory without re-encoding; record_start / record_stop record picture and sound. Files live in the media folder (default Videos\Baird); media_list gives their paths. The device needs the AVerMedia GL310 driver (AVer835_x64.inf, WHQL) and nothing else from AVerMedia: the app reads the hardware H.264 encoder directly. Pictures of the other computer may show private information.
